modernopt.screen.title: ModernOPT Settings
modernopt.screen.subtitle: RENDER CONTROL  •  MINECRAFT 1.21.1
modernopt.option.enabled.desc: Emergency bypass: disables all ModernOPT render interventions.
modernopt.option.scale.desc: Fixed world render scale; dynamic mode can adjust it within your bounds.
modernopt.option.upscaler.desc: Choose how the world image is reconstructed.
modernopt.option.dynamic.desc: Adjust world resolution to approach the target FPS.
modernopt.option.targetfps.desc: Target frame rate from 30 to 540 FPS.
modernopt.option.ssaa.desc: High quality; renders 4× as many pixels.
modernopt.option.fxaa.desc: Lightweight edge smoothing; skipped with Iris shaders.
modernopt.option.msaa.desc: MSAA 2×–16×; 16× falls back to 8× if unsupported. SSAA takes priority.
modernopt.benchmark.title: ModernOPT Benchmark
modernopt.benchmark.requirements: Benchmark requires a local single-player world and Spectator mode.
modernopt.profile.title: Render profile
modernopt.profile.desc: Cycle Quality, Balanced, Performance or Custom presets.
